# Data contracts of the central-banks pack

One section per command of the pack: the shape of its data, how it is stored and checked, and what a person still has to confirm. The rules every contract shares are in [the contracts README](../README.md); the index of every command is [packs/README.md](README.md). The pack's guide, [config/packs/economy/central-banks/guides/central-banks.md](../../../config/packs/economy/central-banks/guides/central-banks.md), shows the same contracts (generated from the same files, tools/packgen/common/guide_data.py) next to how to use the pack and where each kind's data comes from (*Data retrieval*).

| Command | Kind | Class | Status | Fields | To review |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [CBANK](#cbank-central-bank-central-bank) | `central-bank` | fundamental | active | 15 | 0 |
| [CBSER](#cbser-central-bank-series-rate-series) | `rate-series` | fundamental | active | 20 | 0 |

## CBANK: Central bank (`central-bank`)

One central bank: its policy rate, the last move, the rate's history and the market series around it.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [central-bank.contract.yaml](../../../config/packs/economy/central-banks/contracts/central-bank.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | public data: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis; Bank of Canada, pulled by the central-banks feed (config/feeds/central-banks.yaml, tools/feeds/sources/) |
| Grain | One row per central bank, keyed by BANK_ID. |
| Key | `BANK_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^CBANK-` |
| Dated by | `snapshot` |
| Cadence | daily (due: the central-banks feed's schedule (15 22 * * 1-5 UTC); a pull with nothing new writes nothing and the lake keeps its latest date) |
| Storage | connector `centralbank-store` (plugin `delta`), table `<root>/centralbank/central-bank/` |
| Test data | config/packs/economy/central-banks/samples |
| Worked example | [central-banks/central-bank](../samples/central-banks.md#central-bank) (a real record, every field explained, for the production query; tools/testdata/sample_docs.py) |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BANK_ID` | id | required |  | CBANK- and the bank's short id in the feed's YAML (FED, BOC). | `CBANK-BOC` (pattern `^CBANK-`) |  |
| `NAME` | text | required |  | The central bank's name. | `Bank of Canada` |  |
| `COUNTRY` | text | required |  | The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the bank's country. | `CAN` |  |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | text | optional |  | The bank's country. | `Canada` |  |
| `CURRENCY` | text | optional |  | The ISO 4217 code of the bank's currency. | `CAD` |  |
| `WEBSITE` | text | optional |  | The bank's website. | `https://www.bankofcanada.ca` |  |
| `POLICY_RATE` | rate | optional | % | The latest value of the bank's policy-rate series (the Fed: the target range's upper limit; the Bank of Canada: the target for the overnight rate). | `2.5` |  |
| `POLICY_RATE_DATE` | date | optional |  | The date of that value. | `2026-11-05` |  |
| `POLICY_SERIES` | id | optional |  | The rate-series page of the policy rate. | `CBSER-BOC-V39079` (pattern `^CBSER-`) | `rate-series` |
| `LAST_MOVE_DATE` | date | optional |  | The first date the policy rate took its current value, within the history window; empty when it did not move in the window. | `2026-10-29` |  |
| `LAST_MOVE_BP` | amount | optional | bp | The size of that move: the new rate less the old one, in basis points (negative for a cut). | `25.0` |  |
| `POLICY_HISTORY` | record list | required |  | The policy rate by date over the window, oldest first (DATE, VALUE). |  |  |
| `SERIES` | record list | required |  | Every series of the bank the feed follows, one row each: RATE_SERIES, TITLE, LATEST, DATE, CHANGE, UNIT. |  |  |
| `PRESS` | id | optional |  | The bank's publisher page in the official-news pack (PRESS-<id>). | `PRESS-BOC` (pattern `^PRESS-`) | `release-source` |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required |  | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. |  |  |

**Nested `POLICY_HISTORY[]`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DATE` | date | required |  | The observation's date (a monthly series is dated the first of its month). | `2025-10-02` |  |
| `VALUE` | amount | required | the record's UNIT | The observation, in the series' unit. | `2.5` |  |

**Nested `SERIES[]`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RATE_SERIES` | id | required |  | The rate-series page (CBSER-<source>-<code>). | `CBSER-BOC-V39079` (pattern `^CBSER-`) | `rate-series` |
| `TITLE` | text | required |  | The series' title in the feed's YAML. | `Bank of Canada target for the overnight rate` |  |
| `LATEST` | amount | required | the row's UNIT | The series' latest value, in its unit. | `2.5` |  |
| `DATE` | date | required |  | The date of the latest value. | `2026-11-05` |  |
| `CHANGE` | amount | optional | the row's UNIT | The latest value less the previous observation. | `0.0` |  |
| `UNIT` | text | required |  | What the series measures. | `%` |  |

**Nested `PROVENANCE`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SOURCE` | text | required |  | The organisation whose published data the record holds. | `Bank of Canada` |  |
| `DATASET` | text | required |  | The source and the series (or the bank) the record was built from. | `Bank of Canada: policy rate and market series` |  |
| `RETRIEVED_AT` | date | required |  | The business date of the feed's pull that wrote the record. | `2026-11-06` |  |
| `LICENCE` | text | required |  | The terms under which the source allows reuse, as recorded in the feed's YAML. | `Bank of Canada terms of use: free to use, copy, distribute …` |  |
| `ATTRIBUTION` | text | required |  | The credit line to repeat when the data is shown or republished. | `Source: Bank of Canada.` |  |
| `URL` | text | required |  | The source's page for this record. | `https://www.bankofcanada.ca` |  |
| `INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required |  | True when the source's terms forbid redistribution outside the organisation (Export data refuses the record). | `False` |  |

**Links:** `POLICY_SERIES` → `rate-series`, `PRESS` → `release-source`, `SERIES[].RATE_SERIES` → `rate-series`.

**Validation**

- required: fields `BANK_ID`, `NAME`, `COUNTRY`, `POLICY_HISTORY`, `SERIES`, `PROVENANCE`
- unique: key `BANK_ID`; per snapshot
- pattern: field BANK_ID; pattern ^CBANK-
- link: field POLICY_SERIES; kind rate-series
- link: field PRESS; kind release-source
- link: field SERIES[].RATE_SERIES; kind rate-series

**Notes**

- Stored in the worldlake lake (config/lakes/worldlake.yaml), table <data>/delta/worldlake/centralbank/central-bank/, one JSONL.gz a business date loaded with mode replace (a rerun of a day is idempotent).
- Delivered as JSON Lines: one document a line, UTF-8, gzipped, with a .ready file naming the lake, pack, kind, connector, business date, mode, key, sha256 and row count (DATA_LAKE_GUIDE.md section 4).

## CBSER: Central bank series (`rate-series`)

One central-bank or market series from FRED or the Bank of Canada: the history, the latest value, the change on the day and on the year.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [rate-series.contract.yaml](../../../config/packs/economy/central-banks/contracts/rate-series.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | public data: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis; Bank of Canada, pulled by the central-banks feed (config/feeds/central-banks.yaml, tools/feeds/sources/) |
| Grain | One row per central bank series, keyed by SERIES_ID. |
| Key | `SERIES_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^CBSER-` |
| Dated by | `snapshot` |
| Cadence | daily (due: the central-banks feed's schedule (15 22 * * 1-5 UTC); a pull with nothing new writes nothing and the lake keeps its latest date) |
| Storage | connector `centralbank-store` (plugin `delta`), table `<root>/centralbank/rate-series/` |
| Test data | config/packs/economy/central-banks/samples |
| Worked example | [central-banks/rate-series](../samples/central-banks.md#rate-series) (a real record, every field explained, for the production query; tools/testdata/sample_docs.py) |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SERIES_ID` | id | required |  | CBSER-, the source (FRED or BOC) and the source's series code with dots as underscores. | `CBSER-BOC-AVG_INTWO` (pattern `^CBSER-`) |  |
| `NAME` | text | required |  | The series' title, as NAME for search. | `CORRA, Canadian overnight repo rate average` |  |
| `SOURCE` | text | required |  | The source the series is read from: FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis) or the Bank of Canada. | `Bank of Canada`, `FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis` |  |
| `CODE` | text | required |  | The series' code at its source (DGS10, V39079). | `AVG.INTWO` |  |
| `CENTRAL_BANK` | id | required |  | The central-bank page the series belongs to (CBANK-<id>). | `CBANK-BOC` (pattern `^CBANK-`) | `central-bank` |
| `TITLE` | text | required |  | The series' title in the feed's YAML, else the source's own. | `CORRA, Canadian overnight repo rate average` |  |
| `DESCRIPTION` | text | optional |  | The source's description of the series (FRED's notes, the Valet description), cut at 600 characters. | `A measure of the cost of overnight general collateral fundi…` |  |
| `UNIT` | text | required |  | What the series measures (%, percentage points, an index, USD millions, CAD per USD). | `%` |  |
| `FREQUENCY` | text | optional |  | How often the source publishes the series, in its own words. | `Business daily` |  |
| `LATEST` | amount | required | the record's UNIT | The latest observation, in the series' unit. | `2.52` |  |
| `LATEST_DATE` | date | required |  | The date of the latest observation. | `2026-11-05` |  |
| `PREVIOUS` | amount | optional | the record's UNIT | The observation before the latest one. | `2.52` |  |
| `PREVIOUS_DATE` | date | optional |  | The date of the previous observation. | `2026-11-04` |  |
| `CHANGE` | amount | optional | the record's UNIT | The latest observation less the previous one, in the series' unit. | `0.0` |  |
| `CHANGE_1Y` | amount | optional | the record's UNIT | The latest observation less the last one at least a year before it; empty when the window is shorter. | `0.25` |  |
| `HIGH` | amount | required | the record's UNIT | The highest observation in the history window. | `2.56` |  |
| `LOW` | amount | required | the record's UNIT | The lowest observation in the history window. | `2.24` |  |
| `OBSERVATIONS` | integer | required |  | How many observations the history holds. | `273` |  |
| `HISTORY` | record list | required |  | The observations over the window (the feed's history-days), oldest first (DATE, VALUE). |  |  |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required |  | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. |  |  |

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |

| `SOURCE` | text | required |  | The organisation whose published data the record holds. | `Bank of Canada` |  |

- unique: key `SERIES_ID`; per snapshot
